RAIL.stands_in_for: the logic rail at the bottom of the regulator's stated accuracy, which is the worst case for reaching the driver's input high threshold

RLEAKDRV.stands_in_for: the driver's input leakage at its datasheet maximum, as the resistance that sinks it to the reference

RLEAKMCU.stands_in_for: the controller pin's input leakage at its datasheet maximum, as above

RPULLUP.stands_in_for: the enable pull-up at its nominal value
